trust_decision.summary: Markdown text supplied by the caller is untrusted; parsing it must cost work linear in its length, and that guarantee is decided in the per-item merge loops of AttributesListener::processDocument, AttributesBlockContinueParser::tryContinue and the shared AdjacentTextMerger::mergeIfNeeded.

landing_point.why: The summary names SmartPunct first, and this listener replaces each unpaired Quote with a Text node and immediately merges it into its neighbours, so the per-quote loop is the obvious place to look for the quadratic work.

fix_sites.entry_point: MarkdownConverter::convert() with SmartPunctExtension registered -> DocumentParsedEvent -> ReplaceUnpairedQuotesListener::__invoke -> mergeWithDirectlyAdjacentNodes
fix_sites.module_kind: shared Node-layer utility (lower-level merge primitive used by four call sites)

fix_sites.entry_point: AttributesHelper::mergeAttributes, called from AttributesListener, AttributesBlockContinueParser, ApplyDefaultAttributesProcessor and TableCellRenderer

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The merger is generic @internal Node-layer code rather than SmartPunct code, and the fix's own comment says non-class attributes are still merged and filtered per node, so a solver can argue both sit outside the advisory's named class-list/sibling-scan scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Class-list order and duplicates must be preserved: prefix-direction attributes prepend ahead of the existing classes, suffix-direction attributes append behind them, and repeats are kept; a dedupe or reorder 'optimisation' changes expected HTML.

O6_input_shapes: a long run of unpaired quotes, each replaced by a Text node and merged into an ever-growing left Text node (SmartPunct)
repeated inline class tokens targeting one block ('{.c}' x n)
class given as '.a .b' tokens, as a 'class="a b"' key/value, and as a PHP array from default_attributes config
adjacent block-level attribute blocks welded together by erased link-reference definitions ('{#a}\n[a]: u' x n)
attribute blocks separated by blank lines, and consecutive attribute lines merged into a single block
prefix versus suffix direction (attributes before or after their target)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Many adjacent inline attribute nodes each contributing a distinct scalar attribute name to the same target: mergeAttributes() array_merges the growing pending map and filterAttributes() re-scans it with preg_match once per node, so the work remains quadratic in the number of distinct attributes.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The fix's own comment says everything except the class list is 'merged and filtered per node exactly as it would be', and the advisory/changelog only describe the class list, so this path looks deliberately excluded.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the fixed listener, different accumulated state (scalar map rather than class list)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Consecutive attribute lines in one attribute block each contributing a distinct scalar attribute name: tryContinue() still rebuilds the block's growing attribute array with mergeAttributes() on every line.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The comment added by the fix says only the growing class list is quadratic, and the advisory names classes, so distinct scalar keys look unreported.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different stage and file from the listener (block parsing versus document post-processing)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a per-node default-class merge feeding its own growing class/attribute list back through AttributesHelper::mergeAttributes
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: DefaultAttributesExtension already ships that exact call and its schema already allows string[] class values, so a 'default classes' accumulation option is a natural extension.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a renderer that merges per-row or per-cell attribute maps repeatedly, accumulating classes
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it already calls mergeAttributes on every cell, so extending alignment attributes into accumulated class lists repeats the pattern in a renderer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a listener that replaces each node with a Text node and then calls AdjacentTextMerger::mergeWithDirectlyAdjacentNodes, as ReplaceUnpairedQuotesListener does
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it already replaces footnote nodes with Text one at a time, so adding the same neighbour merge is a one-line, natural change.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an in-place append() coalescer whose quadratic twin is setLiteral($lastLiteral . $newText)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: this is the existing correct precedent for coalescing text, and it is exactly the pattern the SmartPunct fix adopts, so a copy that concatenates instead of appending is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a class-string builder appending one class per heading into an attributes/class value
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it already appends to attributes/class per heading, so a repeated heading/slug variant is a plausible place for the same string growth.
